github.description: GitHub operations - PRs, issues, repos. Kept: terrace-control-plane's whole PR workflow (branch, gh pr create, gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch) runs through this.

context7.description: Live documentation lookup. Kept: already installed and in active use at Terrace (see the claude_ai_Context7 / plugin_context7_context7 connectors already wired into this account) -- listed here so a from-scratch terrace-control-plane checkout can stand up the same capability locally.

filesystem.description: Filesystem operations (set your path, e.g. the terrace-control-plane working copy under C:\Users\sward\work).

sequential-thinking.description: Chain-of-thought reasoning scratchpad. Kept as an OPTIONAL nice-to-have, not currently used anywhere in the Terrace stack -- add it only if a session actually wants structured multi-step reasoning support beyond what the model does natively.

_dropped.firecrawl: Not in the task's explicit keep or drop list, but not part of the Terrace stack either: no web-scraping/crawling workflow exists anywhere in terrace-control-plane. Dropped on the same 'not part of this stack' reasoning as the others below; flagged here explicitly since it wasn't named in the porting instructions either way.
_dropped.supabase: No Supabase usage anywhere in terrace-control-plane; the data layer is psycopg3 + plain numbered SQL migrations against hosted Postgres (Neon), not Supabase.
_dropped.vercel: No Vercel deployments in this stack; dashboard/app.py is server-rendered Starlette, deployed to Render, with no Next.js/npm build step.
_dropped.railway: Not part of the Terrace stack; hosting is Render (terrace-ops-v2), not Railway.
_dropped.cloudflare-docs: No Cloudflare usage (Workers, Pages, or otherwise) anywhere in terrace-control-plane.
_dropped.cloudflare-workers-builds: Same as above -- no Cloudflare Workers in this stack.
_dropped.cloudflare-workers-bindings: Same as above -- no Cloudflare Workers in this stack.
_dropped.cloudflare-observability: Same as above -- no Cloudflare usage to observe.
_dropped.clickhouse: No ClickHouse or other analytics-warehouse usage; all data lives in the one Postgres instance (Neon) that psycopg3 talks to directly.
_dropped.magic: UI-generation MCP for React component scaffolding; there's no React/frontend build in this stack (server-rendered Starlette HTML only), so there's nothing for it to generate into.
_dropped.memory: Dropped deliberately, not just as irrelevant: Terrace already runs its own structured, actively-used memory system outside Claude Code's account-level memory. A second, generic MCP memory server sitting alongside it would create two sources of truth for the same kind of state and invite drift between them, which is worse than having neither.

_comments.usage: Copy the servers you need into the consuming repo's ~/.claude.json mcpServers section (or the project-level equivalent).
_comments.env_vars: Replace YOUR_*_HERE placeholders with actual values.
_comments.disabling: Use disabledMcpServers array in project config to disable per-project.
_comments.context_warning: Keep under 10 MCPs enabled to preserve context window -- directly relevant here: this Claude Code account already runs dozens of MCP tools across many first-party connectors (Gmail, Microsoft 365, Notion, Neon, QuickBooks, terrace-ops-v2, etc.), so adding the four kept above should be a deliberate, counted decision, not a default-everything-on one.
